content_of_post_to_answer: What skill takes only a few hours to learn, but will pay off for the rest of your life?
answer: The skills with the highest lifetime returns are often not the ones that take years to master, but the ones that change how you learn everything else. Reading effectively, asking better questions, communicating clearly, and managing attention are examples. The overlooked part is that a skill’s value compounds when it improves your ability to acquire the next skill. The fastest skills to learn are often the ones that make future learning faster.
